collection.job_log_scope: Exact UTF-8 encoding of connector-decoded text; not original GitHub log ZIP bytes.

retention_limits: Standalone ABI matrix temporary object, executables, generated header and harness were deleted by the original qualifier and were not uploaded. Their recorded hashes and actual command/diagnostic traces are retained, but their original bytes cannot be independently rehashed here.
The original GitHub artifact ZIPs are retained byte-for-byte with published GitHub SHA/size. Job logs are the connector-decoded text, not original GitHub log ZIP streams.
CI compiler executables/sysroots and runner memory are not contained in these ZIPs; compiler identities are original-run observations. This audit cannot re-attest the original hosted machine.
scope_limits: These seven host/compiler qualifications are Linux x86_64 GCC/Clang, Linux aarch64 GCC/Clang, Windows x86_64 MSVC/Clang, and macOS aarch64 Clang. No unlisted platform, physical board or GPU is inferred.

C migration covers the complete unchanged stb_divide component in two declared macro variants: six definitions plus six resolved prototypes per variant. The full 433-line header is retained, but disabled tests/configurations are not active declaration coverage.

Every host natively calls the original C implementation and separately generated Rust shared library. HIA is independently interpreted on 58 inputs per variant; optional direct HIA LLVM native and UBSan routes were not requested.
The corpus has 21,453 unique inputs, reused across variants and hosts. Aggregate native observations include both original and translated calls and must not be described as unique test inputs.

The component is scalar, borrow-free arithmetic. Zero allocator counters and interpreter resources do not establish owning-resource migration, failure/cancellation behavior of an upstream allocator API, all-input equivalence or whole-language soundness.
ABI matrix finite declared shapes and negative controls do not establish every C ABI feature or foreign pointer lifetime safety; extern contracts remain assumed_not_verified.
No migration cost/performance superiority or C++ migration claim is established by this workflow.

source_binding.windows_source_binding: Every recorded Python file hash equals exact LF Git bytes transformed to CRLF; original Windows path/hash receipts remain unchanged. Complete upstream fixture bytes stay LF and identical.
